simple.prompt: The developers ___ on this critical software bug for five consecutive hours.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The developers' berpasangan dengan 'have been' + verb-ing ('have been working') untuk aksi yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih terus berlangsung.
hints: Rumus Present Perfect Continuous: have/has been + verb-ing.

simple.prompt: She is completely exhausted because she ___ non-stop since 7:00 a.m.
simple.explanation: Subjek tunggal 'She' berpasangan dengan 'has been driving' untuk aktivitas yang berlangsung terus-menerus dan dampaknya terlihat jelas saat ini.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect Continuous dengan durasi 'all morning'.
simple.targetSentence: It has been raining all morning.
simple.explanation: Subject (It) + has been + Verb-ing (raining) + durasi waktu (all morning).

simple.prompt: How long ___ for the delayed commuter train?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan untuk durasi proses yang masih berlangsung hingga saat ini menggunakan 'How long have you been waiting...?'
hints: Menanyakan durasi aktivitas yang sedang berjalan.
Pola: How long have you been + verb-ing.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya Present Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: Have they been negotiating the contract all week?
simple.explanation: Have + Subject (they) + been + Verb-ing (negotiating) + the contract + all week?

simple.prompt: We ___ this new customer relationship software since last month.
simple.explanation: Kombinasi proses berkelanjutan dengan titik awal 'since last month' memakai 'have been using'.
hints: Aktivitas berlangsung sejak bulan lalu hingga sekarang.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat negatif Present Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: He has not been sleeping well lately.
simple.explanation: Subject (He) + has not been + Verb-ing (sleeping) + well + lately.

simple.prompt: Maya ___ for the regional logistics team since January, and she loves the role.
simple.explanation: Aktivitas yang dimulai Januari lalu dan terus berlangsung aktif hingga kini ('since January') memakai Present Perfect Continuous: 'has been working'.
hints: Rumus subjek tunggal: has + been + V-ing.

simple.prompt: How long ___ you been waiting at the departure lounge?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Present Perfect Continuous untuk 'you' menggunakan auxiliary 'have' ('How long have you been waiting?').

simple.prompt: It ___ raining heavily for three hours, so the courtyard is flooded.
simple.explanation: Hujan berlangsung selama tiga jam hingga sekarang ('for three hours') dan dampaknya tampak sekarang, memakai 'has been' + V-ing.
hints: Subjek 'It' dengan V-ing 'raining' dan durasi 'for three hours'.

simple.prompt: The interns haven't ___ practicing their presentation slides for very long.
simple.explanation: Dalam rumus Present Perfect Continuous negatif ('haven't + been + V-ing'), gunakan past participle 'been'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di ruang kerja mengenai bukti aktivitas yang baru saja berhenti.
dialogue: Your hands are covered in white paint!
Yes, I ___ the exhibition booth all morning.
simple.explanation: Bukti fisik yang tampak jelas sekarang ('hands are covered in paint') akibat aktivitas berdurasi yang baru saja dilakukan memakai 'have been painting'.
hints: Tampak bukti langsung cat di tangan saat berbicara.

simple.prompt: ___ your brother been studying architectural drafting since high school?
simple.explanation: Subjek orang ketiga tunggal 'your brother' di awal kalimat tanya memakai auxiliary 'Has'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk verb setelah 'has been' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: Our software developer has been code this payment module since Monday.
options: Our software developer has been coding this payment module since Monday.
Our software developer has been coded this payment module since Monday.
Our software developer has being coding this payment module since Monday.
simple.explanation: Setelah 'has been' dalam Present Perfect Continuous aktif, kata kerja wajib berbentuk '-ing' ('coding'), bukan bentuk dasar 'code'.
hints: Rumus aktif berkelanjutan: has + been + V-ing.

simple.prompt: We ___ living in this quiet apartment building for almost two years.
simple.explanation: Subjek 'We' + durasi 'for almost two years' memakai 'have been' + V-ing ('living').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect Continuous dengan durasi 'for'.
simple.targetSentence: She has been rehearsing her keynote speech for two hours.
simple.explanation: Subject + has been + V-ing + object + for two hours.

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan durasi memakai 'How long' dan Present Perfect Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: How long have the engineers been testing the solar inverter?
simple.explanation: 'How long + have + Subject + been + V-ing?' menanyakan lama aktivitas yang masih berlangsung.
hints: Mulai dengan 'How long have the engineers'.
Lengkapi dengan 'been testing the solar inverter?'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog penjelasan alasan kondisi fisik saat ini.
dialogue: Why are your clothes covered in white dust?
I apologize; I ___ the ceiling tiles in the storage room.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous digunakan ketika aktivitas baru saja berhenti dan bukti fisik dari proses tersebut terlihat sangat jelas saat ini ('covered in dust').
hints: Fokus pada aktivitas fisik yang menyisakan bukti nyata saat ini.

intermediate.prompt: Contrast: 'I ___ three chapters of the novel today' (Result/completion) vs 'I ___ the novel all afternoon' (Activity/duration).
intermediate.explanation: Ketika fokus pada hasil berapa banyak yang selesai (quantity/completion: 'three chapters'), gunakan Present Perfect Simple ('have read'). Ketika fokus pada durasi aktivitas ('all afternoon'), gunakan Present Perfect Continuous ('have been reading').
hints: Jumlah yang selesai $\rightarrow$ Present Perfect Simple.

intermediate.prompt: How many emails ___ since this morning?
intermediate.explanation: Pertanyaan yang menanyakan kuantitas 'How many / How much' (hasil pencapaian) selalu menggunakan Present Perfect Simple, BUKAN Continuous: 'How many emails have you sent?'.
hints: Menanyakan jumlah item yang sudah tuntas (How many).
Gunakan Present Perfect Simple, bukan Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menyatakan kebiasaan baru temporer dengan 'recently'.
intermediate.targetSentence: She has been exercising at the gym regularly recently.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous sering digunakan untuk kebiasaan baru yang berlangsung akhir-akhir ini (recent temporary habits).

intermediate.prompt: Our analytics platform ___ steadily over the past few weeks.
intermediate.explanation: Proses perbaikan berkelanjutan yang berlangsung bertahap selama kurun waktu tertentu menggunakan 'has been improving'.
hints: Proses yang berlangsung bertahap dalam beberapa minggu terakhir.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya perbandingan hasil vs proses.
intermediate.targetSentence: How long have you been studying English?
intermediate.explanation: How long + have you been + Verb-ing (studying) + English?
hints: Awali dengan 'How long have you been'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk yang tepat untuk aktivitas yang baru saja berakhir.
dialogue: Yes, I ___ up that steep hill.
intermediate.explanation: Kondisi terengah-engah (out of breath) adalah bukti fisik langsung dari proses lari yang baru saja berlangsung: 'have been running'.
hints: Menjelaskan penyebab fisik langsung saat ini.

intermediate.prompt: Compare focus: 'He ___ the quarterly report all afternoon' (emphasizes ongoing process) vs 'He ___ three full chapters already' (emphasizes completed count).
intermediate.explanation: Menekankan proses dan durasi ('all afternoon') memakai Present Perfect Continuous ('has been writing'); menekankan jumlah/hasil tuntas ('three full chapters') memakai Present Perfect Simple ('has written').
hints: Proses berkelanjutan memakai Continuous; jumlah hasil selesai memakai Simple.

intermediate.prompt: I ___ staying at my cousin's place this week while my apartment floors are being polished.
intermediate.explanation: Situasi sementara yang dimulai beberapa hari lalu dan masih berlangsung minggu ini memakai Present Perfect Continuous ('have been staying').
hints: Situasi sementara 'this week' dari beberapa hari lalu hingga sekarang.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kantor mengenai dampak pekerjaan yang belum selesai.
dialogue: Why does the meeting room still look so cluttered?
We ___ the old archive binders, and we still have two shelves left.
intermediate.explanation: Aktivitas masih setengah jalan ('still have two shelves left') memakai Present Perfect Continuous ('have been sorting') untuk menandakan pekerjaan belum tuntas.
hints: Aktivitas belum tuntas hingga kini memakai Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Digital payment adoption ___ steadily across suburban markets over the past eighteen months.
intermediate.explanation: Tren perubahan bertahap yang terus naik selama periode hingga saat ini memakai bentuk aktif 'has been rising' ('rise' intransitif, bukan 'been risen').
hints: Tren naik berlangsung bertahap sampai kini.

intermediate.prompt: How many quarterly audits ___ your team completed so far this year?
intermediate.explanation: Karena fokusnya menanyakan JUMLAH hasil yang sudah selesai ('How many quarterly audits'), gunakan Present Perfect Simple ('has ... completed'), bukan Continuous.
hints: Kata kunci 'How many...' menanyakan kuantitas hasil selesai.
Gunakan Present Perfect Simple: 'has + S + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penggunaan stative verb dalam bentuk Present Perfect Continuous berikut.
intermediate.draft: I have been knowing Dr. Anwar since we attended the Bandung symposium together.
options: I have known Dr. Anwar since we attended the Bandung symposium together.
I have been know Dr. Anwar since we attended the Bandung symposium together.
I am knowing Dr. Anwar since we attended the Bandung symposium together.
intermediate.explanation: 'Know' adalah stative verb keadaan pikiran yang tidak boleh memakai bentuk '-ing' ('have been knowing'); gunakan Present Perfect Simple 'have known'.

intermediate.prompt: Why are your shoes so muddy? — I ___ through the community garden after the rain.
intermediate.explanation: Efek yang terlihat saat ini (sepatu berlumpur) dijelaskan oleh aktivitas fisik berdurasi baru-baru ini: 'have been walking'.
hints: Bukti tampak langsung di masa kini (sepatu kotor).

intermediate.prompt: She hasn't been feeling energetic lately because she ___ overtime all month.
intermediate.explanation: Penjelasan aktivitas intens berulang sepanjang bulan ini hingga kini memakai 'has been working'.
hints: Penanda 'all month' hingga kini + efek kelelahan sekarang.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect Simple vs Continuous yang menekankan tugas belum tuntas.
intermediate.targetSentence: I have been reading this economics textbook since May, and I am on chapter six.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous ('have been reading') tepat karena buku masih dibaca ('on chapter six').
hints: Awali dengan 'I have been reading this economics textbook'.
Tambahkan 'since May, and I am on chapter six'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang kontras menggunakan Present Perfect Simple untuk jumlah tuntas.
intermediate.targetSentence: She has sent twenty-five client proposals since nine this morning.
intermediate.explanation: Penyebutan angka pasti hasil yang telah diselesaikan ('twenty-five...') memakai Present Perfect Simple ('has sent').
hints: Awali dengan 'She has sent twenty-five client proposals'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penggunaan stative verb dalam bentuk Present Perfect Continuous.
complex.draft: We have been knowing our senior business partner for over twenty years.
options: We have known our senior business partner for over twenty years.
We have been known our senior business partner for over twenty years.
We are knowing our senior business partner for over twenty years.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja stative (know, believe, understand, belong, own) TIDAK boleh berbentuk continuous (-ing). Gunakan Present Perfect Simple: 'We have known...'.
hints: 'Know' adalah kata kerja stative yang pantang memakai -ing.
Ubah menjadi Present Perfect Simple 'have known'.

complex.prompt: Notice the difference with permanent vs temporary residence: 'My family ___ in this ancestral home for centuries' (Permanent) vs 'I ___ with a friend until my apartment is ready' (Temporary).
complex.explanation: Keadaan yang dipandang sangat permanen (rumah leluhur berabad-abad) cenderung memakai Simple ('has lived'), sedangkan situasi sementara jangka pendek memakai Continuous ('have been staying').

complex.prompt: Someone ___ my artisanal coffee! There is only half a cup left! (Incomplete action / annoyance).
complex.explanation: Ketika aksi belum selesai (kopi masih tersisa separuh) dan si pembicara merasa jengkel, gunakan Present Perfect Continuous: 'has been drinking'. Sebaliknya 'has drunk' berarti kopi habis total diminum.
hints: Kopinya belum habis total (hanya diminum sebagian).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat komparasi stative verb kepemilikan dengan 'have had'.
complex.targetSentence: We have had this server for five years.
complex.explanation: 'Have' bermakna kepemilikan (possession) adalah stative verb, sehingga memakai 'have had', bukan *have been having.
hints: Gunakan bentuk 'We have had this server'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan bentuk continuous pada kata kerja pencapaian yang tuntas seketika (achievement verbs).
complex.draft: The legal department has been finally winning the trademark dispute.
options: The legal department has finally won the trademark dispute.
The legal department is finally winning the trademark dispute.
The legal department was finally winning the trademark dispute.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja pencapaian seketika (achievement/punctual verbs seperti win, lose, find, stop, finish) tidak berdurasi panjang, sehingga tidak cocok memakai Present Perfect Continuous jika tuntas. Gunakan: 'has finally won'.
hints: 'Win' adalah peristiwa seketika (bukan proses panjang berdurasi).

complex.prompt: Throughout the ongoing corporate restructuring, the leadership team ___ transparent communication.
complex.explanation: Menekankan proses prioritas yang terus dikedepankan secara berkelanjutan sepanjang restrukturisasi: 'has been prioritizing'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog audit kinerja dengan pembedaan nuansa selesai vs berkelanjutan.
dialogue: Have you finished drafting the quarterly strategic forecast?
Not quite yet, but I ___ on it steadily all morning.
complex.explanation: Pekerjaan belum tuntas ('Not quite yet') dan prosesnya masih berjalan: 'have been working on it'.
hints: Pekerjaan belum tuntas dan masih berjalan.

complex.prompt: Why is Present Perfect Continuous unnatural in 'Someone has been dropping this glass vase on the floor'?
options: 'Drop' is a punctual single-moment event, not an ongoing repeated process here
Present Perfect Continuous cannot be used with 'someone'
'Has been dropping' requires future time markers
complex.explanation: Verb aksi sekejap (punctual verb seperti 'drop', 'break', 'explode' untuk satu kejadian tunggal) tidak dapat berlangsung berdurasi; gunakan Present Perfect Simple ('has dropped').
hints: Periksa sifat kata kerja 'drop' untuk satu vas tunggal.
Satu aksi seketika yang selesai memakai Simple, bukan Continuous.

complex.prompt: Contrast: 'The machine ___ every hour since midnight' (repeated discrete failures) vs 'The alarm ___ once since midnight.'
complex.explanation: Aksi singkat yang berulang-ulang berkali-kali dalam suatu rentang waktu ('every hour since midnight') BISA memakai Continuous ('has been stopping'); kejadian satu kali ('once') memakai Simple ('has stopped').
hints: Kejadian singkat yang diulang-ulang bisa memakai Continuous.
Satu kejadian tunggal tetap memakai Simple.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggabungan stative verb kepemilikan dan Continuous pada kalimat formal berikut.
complex.draft: Our university has been possessing this rare botanical manuscript for over a century.
options: Our university has possessed this rare botanical manuscript for over a century.
Our university has been possess this rare botanical manuscript for over a century.
Our university possesses this rare botanical manuscript since a century.
complex.explanation: 'Possess' (sama seperti 'own' dan 'belong') adalah stative verb kepemilikan tetap; gunakan Present Perfect Simple ('has possessed') untuk durasi 'for over a century'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang nuansa kerja sementara vs permanen pada 'live/work'.
dialogue: You wrote 'Dr. Lin has lived in Boston for twenty years' and 'I have been staying in Boston for two weeks.' Is the tense shift intentional?
Yes! Present Perfect Simple highlights her long-term permanent base, while Continuous highlights ___.
complex.explanation: Dengan verb seperti 'live', 'work', dan 'study', Present Perfect Simple cenderung memberi kesan lebih permanen/panjang, sedangkan Continuous menonjolkan sifat sementara ('two weeks').
hints: Bandingkan 20 tahun vs 2 minggu tinggal sementara.
Continuous sangat alami untuk situasi sementara jangka pendek.

complex.prompt: Local artisans ___ traditional rattan baskets in this valley for generations, though recently plastic imports have threatened sales.
complex.explanation: Tradisi berkelanjutan dari generasi ke generasi hingga saat ini tetap dapat memakai Present Perfect Continuous ('have been weaving') untuk menonjolkan kontinuitas aktifnya.
hints: Aktivitas kerajinan berlangsung turun-temurun hingga sekarang.

complex.prompt: Why is 'Who has been reading my confidential notes?' pragmatically different from 'Who has read my confidential notes?'
options: Continuous expresses irritation or visible disorder left behind right now
Simple is grammatically incorrect for questions starting with 'Who'
Continuous refers exclusively to events scheduled tomorrow
complex.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous dalam kalimat seperti 'Who has been eating my lunch / reading my notes?' sering membawa nada emosional terkejut/jengkel akibat tanda-tanda yang tersisa di lokasi.
hints: Perhatikan nuansa perasaan/tanda yang terlihat saat pembicara masuk ruangan.
Continuous menyorot bekas aktivitas baru saja dan emosi pembicara.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan tense pada kalimat laporan riset yang mencampur angka pasti hasil dengan Continuous.
complex.draft: Over the last decade, climate researchers have been publishing exactly 140 peer-reviewed papers in this dataset.
options: Over the last decade, climate researchers have published exactly 140 peer-reviewed papers in this dataset.
Over the last decade, climate researchers published exactly 140 peer-reviewed papers since 2016.
Over the last decade, climate researchers had been publishing exactly 140 peer-reviewed papers now.
complex.explanation: Begitu jumlah hasil tuntas disebutkan secara eksplisit ('exactly 140 peer-reviewed papers'), aspek wajib menggunakan Present Perfect Simple ('have published'), bukan Continuous.
hints: Angka kuantitas hasil selesai ('exactly 140...') mengunci kalimat ke Present Perfect Simple.

complex.prompt: The investigative committee ___ financial records for six months and still expects to issue its final report next quarter.
complex.explanation: Komite bertindak sebagai pelaku aktif proses audit yang masih berjalan 6 bulan hingga sekarang, dan belum selesai: 'has been auditing'.
hints: Subjek 'The investigative committee' adalah pelaku aktif (bukan pasif).
Proses masih berlanjut hingga kuartal depan.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat formal memakai stative verb dengan Present Perfect Simple (bukan Continuous).
complex.targetSentence: Several coastal municipalities have belonged to the climate alliance since 2019.
complex.explanation: 'Belong' adalah stative verb sehingga wajib memakai Present Perfect Simple ('have belonged'), bukan Continuous.
hints: Awali dengan 'Several coastal municipalities have belonged'.
Akhiri dengan 'to the climate alliance since 2019'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menunjukkan pengulangan aksi sekejap memakai Continuous.
complex.targetSentence: The smoke detector has been beeping intermittently all morning.
complex.explanation: Bunyi singkat berulang terus ('intermittently all morning') tepat memakai Present Perfect Continuous ('has been beeping').
hints: Mulai dengan 'The smoke detector has been beeping'.
